NU.selection_reason: Most-active constituent with a two-letter ticker and a consumer brand that differs from the listed legal name; stresses both false-positive control and brand recall.

aliases.binding: Issuer-controlled Nu International release describes Nubank operations as driving Nu Holdings results.

MARA.selection_reason: Most-active constituent that changed its legal name from Marathon Digital Holdings; stresses recall of a former issuer name without substring expansion.

aliases.binding: Issuer-hosted 8-K states the legal name changed from Marathon Digital Holdings, Inc. to MARA Holdings, Inc. on 2024-08-29.

T.selection_reason: Most-active constituent with a one-letter ticker; stresses whether a bare common letter can contaminate issuer attribution.

SOFI.selection_reason: Most-active consumer-finance brand whose capitalization and legal suffix vary across news publishers.

JBLU.selection_reason: Appears in both day-gainers and most-active lists; a consumer brand is embedded in, but shorter than, the legal name.

INTC.selection_reason: Highest-volume name in the live screen and a dense cross-issuer semiconductor news environment.

NOK.selection_reason: High-volume sponsored ADR; stresses issuer matching across US listing labels and the foreign legal issuer name.

FOUR.selection_reason: Day-gainer with a common-word ticker but a distinctive issuer brand; controls ticker qualification and legal-name recall.

CLS.selection_reason: Day-gainer and long-horizon momentum name with supplier/customer news contamination risk.

RGEN.selection_reason: Day-gainer in life sciences with a distinctive legal name and lower news density, serving as a clean recall control.

sec_access.reason: No truthful SEC contact identity was configured; SEC network requests were not made.
